The resolution source for this market is Binance, specifically the ETH/USDT "Low" prices available at https://www.binance.com/en/trade/ETH_USDT, with the chart settings on "1m" for one-minute candles selected on the top bar.

Please note that the outcome of this market depends solely on the price data from the Binance ETH/USDT trading pair. Prices from other exchanges, different trading pairs, or spot markets will not be considered for the resolution of this market.

forecasts.baseline_scope: same preforecast observed two-sided quote; not an independent predictive feature

forecasts.hypothesis: Gaussian zero-log-drift first passage, integrating uncertain future-day starting price
forecasts.failure_conditions: Constant volatility, continuous first passage and no jumps; uncalibrated tails
performance_criteria: event-disjoint verified-outcome Brier/log-loss versus contemporaneous market
calibration and uncertainty before any edge claim
forecasts.risk_assumptions: Research only; [0,1] model uncertainty; no automatic admission, sizing or orders
forecasts.source_independence: Both challengers share Binance data and are NOT independent corroboration
